profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Chewy
profile.summary: I am a front-end developer with experience in the full stack. My main areas of expertise include JavaScript, React/Redux, AngularJS, jQuery, CSS/3, and HTML/5. I have also worked on .net and coldfusion in the past, but I mainly focus on the front-end now.

positions.title: Sr. Front-end Engineer
positions.description:
2019-2021
I work on AWS Computer Vision, building consoles and tools for machine learning models based on images/videos. Still working on the UI, not the back end pieces.

2015-2019
I worked on Amazon Last Mile, including products such as: Amazon Flex and Delivery service providers. I built web views for our delivery app, marketing websites, and internal websites to manage the platforms.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description: I work on all aspects of the front-end including, but not limited to: page layout, page style, user experience, animations, JavaScript, and ajax.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: I implement front end and back end solutions passed down as 'proof of concept' from the business and Information Architects.  My projects expand the functionality of www.hayneedle.com as well as make it more efficient.

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description: I worked on desktop applications both using vb.net and c#.net. I also worked on several websites using classic asp.net as well as vb6.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
The experiments I set up were a bulk solution of water or water mixed with BaCl or CaCl.  On top of the solution I used a syringe to put a monolayer of material such as proteins.  Once the experiment was set up I used a linux machine to control the trough that the materials were put in.  The tests I conducted were the isotherm to get the surface tension to an acceptable value, reflectivity and fluorescence to measure how much of the chemicals from the bulk solution interacted with the surface protein.

After the experiments were complete I used a mix of cplot and gnuplot to make graphs that were easy to read for myself and others who may not have been there for every step of the process.  Once all the graphs were completed we studied the info to see if there was anything out of the ordinary or if it turned out as we had expected.

After we were confident that we had the correct numbers and had done a successful experiment we began to write the entire process into a paper, which after numerous revisions was submitted to science journals for publication.

positions.title: Exterior Foreman
positions.description:
As the exterior foreman my main job was to take care of all events, shows, cleanliness and general upkeep of the outdoors.  Iowa State Center consisted of 4 buildings: CY Stephens Auditorium, Fisher Theatre, Scheman Building and Hilton Coliseum.  The exterior included a courtyard between all the buildings, all the areas around the buildings and several large parking lots.

Since this was in Iowa the outdoor events were mainly in the summertime.  These events included: concerts, national special olympics, luncheons, car shows, fireman smokehouse training, fireworks shows and many more.  My work was not just limited to the outdoors, however.  As a foreman I still worked at shows on the inside when there was nothing for me to do outside.  This taught me many skills about construction and maintenance as well as leadership.  Foreman is as high as you can get before becoming a full time employee and so the foreman were the ones in charge of everybody else.  Crews could get to upwards of 100 people depending on the show with about 6-10 foreman around.
